items.title: Close the fromDraft bootstrap metadata transaction generically
items.context: Root cause: story_create --fromDraft writes active story files and deletes draft files in main, then dev_start creates the story branch/worktree without committing the main mirror transaction. Fix the generic CLI/handler flow so no story-id-specific cleanup is needed.
items.userSees: 用户看到 "Story B-xxxx created from draft ..."、"路径: .../.worktrees/B-xxxx"，随后 "git status --porcelain" 没有任何输出。

happy.desc: Create a story from an approved draft in a temporary git repo; the command prints the story id plus worktree bootstrap/cd guidance, records worktree metadata, and leaves the main worktree with an empty git status.

edge.desc: When fromDraft deletes draft metadata and writes active story metadata in the same bootstrap flow, those main-side metadata changes are closed by a generic transaction before the story branch/worktree is created.

adversarial.desc: If fromDraft bootstraps a worktree but leaves any tracked or untracked story/draft metadata residue in main, the verification must fail with a direct clean-main assertion instead of relying on manual cleanup.

verificationEvidence.note: Targeted smoke creates an approved draft, runs story_create --fromDraft, sees worktree output, confirms story.worktree is recorded, and asserts main git status is empty.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: fromDraft CLI path now stages only the active story dir and source draft dir, commits that bounded metadata transaction on main, and merges main into the new story worktree.
Smoke includes a hard clean-main assertion, so any tracked or untracked story/draft residue after fromDraft bootstrap fails the test.

items.title: Add regression coverage for clean main after fromDraft worktree creation
items.context: Existing worktree-authority smoke only checks worktree existence. Extend it to assert main git status is clean after story_create --fromDraft and that story branch contains main, reproducing the plasmid failure shape.
items.userSees: 用户运行目标 smoke 后看到 "✓ worktree authority smoke passed"；如果 main 有 story/draft residue 或 story branch 不包含 main，命令直接失败。

happy.desc: The targeted worktree-authority smoke runs the fromDraft path and asserts three concrete outcomes: worktree exists, main git status is empty, and story/B-* contains main via merge-base ancestry.

edge.desc: The smoke covers the field shape where INIT_CHECK/worktree metadata exists but the bootstrap transaction would otherwise leave active story or draft metadata changes behind in the main checkout.

adversarial.desc: If the fromDraft branch is created from a stale base that does not contain current main, or if main has dirty metadata after bootstrap, the smoke must fail before reporting success.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke now asserts worktree registration, empty main git status, and merge-base ancestry from main to story/B-* after story_create --fromDraft.
The regression covers the field failure shape by checking main for active story or draft metadata residue immediately after INIT_CHECK/worktree bootstrap.
The test fails if story/B-* does not contain current main or if main remains dirty after bootstrap, preventing a misleading success.

items.title: Verify fromDraft flow and affected Koala validation tasks
items.context: Run the targeted smoke plus package checks needed for a worktree/gate orchestration change, then record verification evidence through Koala CLI.
items.userSees: 用户看到目标 smoke 和验证命令均通过，并且 Koala checklist evidence 记录覆盖 "clean main" 与 "story branch contains main"。

happy.desc: Run the targeted worktree-authority smoke from the story worktree and record passing evidence tied to the fromDraft clean-main and branch-ancestry intents.
Run the affected package or Koala validation command set required for a worktree/gate orchestration change and record passing evidence through checklist_update.

edge.desc: Evidence is recorded against the current story HEAD/material hash so koala validate does not accept stale smoke results after implementation or test changes.

adversarial.desc: koala validate must block TEST/DONE if the targeted smoke is missing, failed, or stale, especially for the clean-main and story-branch-contains-main assertions.

verificationEvidence.note: Targeted smoke passed in the story worktree and covers clean-main plus branch-ancestry intents.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:init-check-bootstrap
verificationEvidence.note: TypeScript build passed and INIT_CHECK bootstrap regression still passes, showing ordinary branch isolation remains intact.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke && npm run test:init-check-bootstrap
verificationEvidence.note: Evidence was recorded after implementation commits 04700618/d67c0fcc and fresh targeted validation commands passed.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke && npm run test:init-check-bootstrap
verificationEvidence.note: The already-run build, targeted smoke, and INIT_CHECK bootstrap regression cover the adversarial case: clean-main and branch-ancestry assertions are explicit, so missing or failed targeted coverage cannot be mistaken for a passing implementation.
